analysis:
The PR is documentation-only. Two files change: docs/architecture/hardware-support.md (head lines 534-541) and docs/architecture/inference.md (head hunk at about lines 956-1003). The changes describe an excluded startup shape warmup for ordinary EngineV2 slots, a 20 s wall budget, a cold-shader-cache probe, a 3-try cell rule, and a periodic MLX pool sweep that waits during calibration sessions. No code, protocol, wire or deployment changes are visible, so no control is observably weakened.

Threat-model checks:
- A-001, T-041 and T-028 (prefix cache, cross-tenant TTFT oracle, residual GPU data). The warmup runs synthetic prompts generated locally, not consumer data. The docs say probes and cells publish no observations or work totals. Whether warmup probes can donate synthetic prefixes to the SSD prefix cache is not covered by the docs. Any such entries would carry no consumer plaintext, and the cacheSalt scoping is unaffected. The implementation was not supplied, so this is an integration question.
- TB-002 and TB-011 (registration and serving authorization). The docs say the startup preload warmup runs before registration, so routed traffic cannot preempt it, and the registration gate timeout still bounds it. That is an availability and ordering note, not an authorization change. Warmup also reuses the same KV and service budgets and the foreground lease, so consumer requests still preempt it. T-010 and T-029 availability is therefore not obviously worsened.
- The unverified implementation contract is that the shapeWarmup code in ModelCalibrationPolicy.swift and EngineV2Bridge+ShapeWarmup.swift honors the 20 s budget and the preemption semantics. It was not provided, so this pass cannot confirm it.
- The environment variable DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SHAPE_WARMUP=0 or 'always' is local operator configuration. It is not an adversarial boundary beyond the existing operator (ADV-001) assumptions.

No security regression or invalidated threat assumption was identified in the supplied docs. The docs' claims about the code remain unverified against source.
